name: Teleportation Mastery (Item Mastery, Mythic)
body:
You can “persuade” a teleportation magic item to bring you almost anywhere.

Prerequisite(s): Teleportation Mastery.

Benefit(s): You gain an additional daily use of Teleportation Mastery at 1st mythic tier, plus one additional use at 4th, 7th, and 10th tier. By expending mythic power, you can force the item to cast a higher-level conjuration (teleportation) spell.

This spell may have a level equal to 4 + 1 for every use of mythic power spent.
